title: The Enchanted Archive
video_prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: Premium live-action magical adventure cinema with rich jewel colors, polished anamorphic lenses, warm lantern light, and delicate golden dust in the air. Inside an ancient circular archive, a woman in an emerald robe stands at the left and a man in a brown coat stands at the right, both close to a carved desk with an orange cat sitting prominently between them. The cat raises its head and meows, the woman reacts with a small smile and speaks, and the man listens before giving a calm answer. Amber light wraps around their faces while tall shelves and brass details fall into soft bokeh behind them. The camera makes a gentle forward drift through one continuous medium three-shot with every face clearly visible.
